$comment: Source of truth for repository labels. Sync with `npm run labels:sync` (or the Sync labels workflow on main). Labels not listed here are left untouched.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Improvements or additions to documentation

labels.name: chore
labels.description: Maintenance, refactoring or tooling with no user-facing change

labels.name: security
labels.description: Security fix or hardening

labels.name: performance
labels.description: Speed, memory or resource usage

labels.name: test
labels.description: Test coverage, flakiness or test infrastructure

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Dependency updates

labels.name: accessibility
labels.description: Barrier affecting people with disabilities

labels.name: priority: P0
labels.description: Critical: broken install, data loss, billing or security; drop everything

labels.name: priority: P1
labels.description: High: major feature broken without workaround; next release

labels.name: priority: P2
labels.description: Medium: degraded behavior with a workaround

labels.name: priority: P3
labels.description: Low: polish, minor annoyance or nice to have

labels.name: area: cli
labels.description: bin/ctg.mjs, command routing, headless and JSON output

labels.name: area: native-tui
labels.description: Native TUI plugin UI (plugins/carthagent/src/ui, tui.tsx)

labels.name: area: plugin-server
labels.description: Native plugin server and RPC (plugins/carthagent/src/server, *-rpc.ts)

labels.name: area: runtime
labels.description: CTG-owned runtime, patches, vendor and runtime provisioning

labels.name: area: delivery
labels.description: Ship/delivery engine, planning, checks and review

labels.name: area: cloud
labels.description: Carthagent Cloud client, sign-in, credentials and billing

labels.name: area: voyages
labels.description: Voyages profile, wallet, shop and daily goals

labels.name: area: browser
labels.description: Browser automation, WebDriver and CDP tooling

labels.name: area: web-dashboard
labels.description: Local web dashboard (server.mjs, public/)

labels.name: area: ci
labels.description: GitHub Actions, quality gates and repository tooling

labels.name: area: release
labels.description: Packaging, release workflows, installers and update channels

labels.name: status: triage
labels.description: New; needs priority and area

labels.name: status: needs-repro
labels.description: Cannot act until it is reproduced

labels.name: status: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on an external dependency or decision

labels.name: source: crash-report
